title: Vampire Vape Koncept Tropical Mango E-Liquid ShortFill 50ml
description: Tropical Mango is a new addition to the brand new Koncept range from vape legends Vampire Vape. Deliciously sunny, ripe mangos transport you to a tropical paradise soaked in sunshine. Smooth, juicy and refreshing, this is a delightful eliquid for fruit lovers. These short fill bottles contain 50ml of nicotine-free liquid, with 10ml of extra space within the bottle to accommodate your nicotine shot of choice. This allows you to create a liquid with your own desired nicotine strength. Typically, adding a 10ml nicotine shot to a 50ml short fill will give you 60ml of 3mg e-liquid. Once you have added your preferred amount of nicotine, make sure you shake the contents of the short fill bottle well.
